g.text: short-circuit — WireGuard Mesh with Optional Nord-Protected Egress
peer_transit and nord-vpn are mutually exclusive.
Public DNS belongs to the canonical mesh binding.
Render only: no install, secret creation, image build,
Nord login, systemd/Podman start, route change, or live test.
Hard preflight: native Linux, rootful Podman 5.8+,
IPv4/IPv6 interface prohibits survive an nftables flush.
Guard persists when the container stops.
Raw wg-quick up, wg setconf, and live peer mutation
bypass this contract and are unsupported.
Persistent UTC timer stops WireGuard at expires_at;
BindsTo/PartOf WireGuard, with no reverse After ordering.
preferred route falls away and terminal guard remains.
The temporary macOS hub remains host-only.
No persistent leaf-side kill switch is installed;
WireGuard teardown can restore the leaf's ordinary WAN.
no token argv/env; exact no-echo prompt
